answer: Each task inlet hands a new ID a unique memory-hard puzzle seeded from that ID's key and the current beacon value, so answers can't be precomputed or reused. Solving one takes about 4 GB of RAM for ten minutes, and the beacon rotates every epoch. A farm with 200 fakes has to rent 200 parallel machines, every epoch, because one solution never verifies under a second key. Verifiers spot-check with a quill transcript in seconds. Cost grows linearly with fakes, and skipping one epoch drops that ID's work queue.
